parametric-circles-lines-both.alt: Left: the circle x(t) = 2 cos t, y(t) = 2 sin t. The radius to the point at t = pi/3 makes angle t with the positive x-axis; the trip starts at (2, 0) when t = 0 and arrows show counterclockwise travel. Right: the segment x(t) = 1 + 4t, y(t) = 4 minus 3t from (1, 4) at t = 0 to (5, 1) at t = 1, with the midpoint (3, 2.5) at t = 0.5.

parametric-circles-lines-circle.alt: A circle with center (2, 1) and radius 3. The trip starts at (5, 1), marked t = 0, and arrows show counterclockwise travel. The center is marked.

parametric-circles-lines-segment.alt: A straight segment from (-2, 5), marked t = 0, to (6, 1), marked t = 4, with an arrow pointing from the first point toward the second.
